subject: MSA / Order Form — downstream vendor substitution and DPA annex request
body:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudstream.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Subject: Vendor substitution notice & DPA annex request

Hi Kimberly —

Per our vendor lifecycle change process, Cloudstream needs to add a downstream subcontractor (Inarys Technologies) that will provide logging and transient cache eligibility for part of our order form. This is a substitution (not an expansion) of an existing subprocessor.

Attached: Cloudstream-Change-Notice.pdf (short summary), cloudstream_SOC2_summary.pdf (SOC2 summary).

Requesting:
- Confirmation of Redwoods' process to accept vendor substitutions under the existing MSA + Order Form.
- If required, an executed DPA annex or signed order form amendment to capture the subcontracting path.
- Any baseline evidence you require (SOC2, encryption-at-rest, data residency confirmation).

Timing: our go-live window is flexible but would like to close approvals by 23 May if possible.

Contact for Inarys: procurement@inarys.com (cc'd on separate thread).

Thanks,
Samir Khan\Director, Partnerships\Cloudstream Partners

--- Original attachment stubs: Cloudstream-Change-Notice.pdf (1 page summary), cloudstream_SOC2_summary.pdf (3 pages) ---

--- Message 2 of 5 ---
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudstream.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Vendor substitution notice & DPA annex request

Samir — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Legal (Laura) and Procurement (Marissa).

Immediate asks from our side:
- Marissa: can your team validate the vendor substitution against our vendor acceptance matrix (scope of access, shared data types, transit vs persisted)? If Inarys will handle any data at rest, we need encryption & key management details.
- Laura: please advise whether we can process as a routine "subprocessor substitution" under the current MSA/DPA or whether you want a formal DPA annex and order form amendment. If the latter, please outline minimal redline language we should request (eg. downstream obligations, liability carveouts, audit rights).

Samir — if you can provide the proposed DPA annex or a suggested order form redline this week, that will speed things up. If procurement@inarys.com can share SOC2 or equivalent evidence, attach it to the thread.

I will consolidate and schedule a short call only if legal asks for language changes.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park\Head of Sales Operations\Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 of 5 ---
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 09:20:00 -0700
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Vendor substitution notice & DPA annex request

Team — quick read: this looks like a standard downstream substitution but there are two items that pull it out of "routine" territory.

1) Persistent access: the change notice suggests Inarys will have transient KV/cache access but the SOC2 summary references logs retained for 30 days. Need clarity on whether Inarys will persist any customer-identifiable logs. If yes, we must tighten retention + deletion language in the DPA annex.

2) Geo/residency: confirm whether Processing will remain within US regions. If data flows to eu/APAC, we need to evaluate cross-border clauses.

Proposed next steps (I'm attaching a short redline to the DPA annex):
- Ask Cloudstream to accept a DPA annex that:
  - adds explicit prohibition of onward subcontracting without prior written consent,
  - requires SOC2 Type II or equivalent within last 12 months,
  - sets maximum log retention for Inarys at 7 days unless customer-approved,
  - preserves Redwood audit and termination rights.

- If Cloudstream insists on a simple notification route, we can accept that only if Inarys is limited to ephemeral, in-memory caching (no logs), and we receive attestation signed by both Cloudstream and Inarys.

I've attached: proposed_dpa_annex_redline.docx (excerpted clauses). Marissa — please check whether this triggers any pricing/orderform changes. Tessa — ops input on dataflow/retention.

Laura Bennett\Senior Counsel, Contracts\Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stub: proposed_dpa_annex_redline.docx (redline excerpts) ---

--- Message 4 of 5 ---
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 08:45:00 -0700
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudstream.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@inarys.com
Subject: Re: Vendor substitution notice & DPA annex request

Kimberly / team — appreciate the swift review. Quick updates from Cloudstream and Inarys: 

- Inarys confirms they will only cache ephemeral request / token metadata for up to 14 days and can reduce to 7 days on request. They do not persist PII fields but logs include timestamps and request IDs.
- Inarys provided SOC2 overview and an attestation letter; attached: cloudstream_SOC2_summary.pdf (Cloudstream), Inarys SOC2 summarized in the attestation.
- We are comfortable with a DPA annex. We pushed back to keep retention at 14 days; can accept 7 in markets with strict regs.

Attached: proposed_orderform_redline.docx (shows substitution line in the order form), Cloudstream-Change-Notice.pdf, cloudstream_SOC2_summary.pdf.

Action requested: please confirm whether the attached proposed_dpa_annex_redline.docx from Laura is acceptable or propose final wording. If Legal signs off, we'll execute a Docusign amendment.

Best,
Samir

--- Message 5 of 5 ---
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 15:47:00 -0700
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@cloudstream.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Vendor substitution notice & DPA annex request

Thanks Samir — good updates and appreciate Inarys' flexibility on retention. Summary and owners:

- Legal (Laura): accept the redline in proposed_dpa_annex_redline.docx with one minor edit to retention language: retention default 7 days; allow 14 days only when explicitly justified per-regional compliance with prior written notice. Laura will circulate final snippet by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement (Marissa): verify Inarys' attestation and SOC2 link; confirm no pricing impact / order form implication beyond the substitution clause. Marissa to confirm by 21 May.
- Ops (Tessa): validate that the transient caching pattern described (ephemeral tokens/timestamps, no PII persisted) is operationally achievable; flag any infra exceptions. Tessa to confirm by 21 May.

If all three owners confirm by 21 May we will proceed to DocuSign amendment for the DPA annex and an order form substitution statement. Samir — I'll send the DocuSign link once Laura confirms language.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/links/secure/amendment-RW-CLD-2025-67

Closing note: we prefer the annex approach rather than repeated order form amendments when the change is purely a substitution and scope doesn't expand. That keeps audit trails tidy.

Thanks everyone,
Kimberly Park\Head of Sales Operations\Redwood Inference

--- End of thread ---
